texts: mixed: the arriver is correctly the unknown and the place and year bind, but "the late summer of Year 1" has no licensed time term - the translator had to coin a bare late_summer symbol and lift the year out of the genitive by hand, so the question only matches a statement that happened to be worded the same way ("in the summer of Year 1" or "late in summer" would store something else and the question would miss). Split the two time adjuncts and keep one fixed wording for the season everywhere in the stream: "Who arrived in Aelmere in late summer, in Year 1?" If your world names months, naming the month instead of the season removes the guess entirely, since months are a time term the translator has.
